info.title: Documented ZAI operations missing from the upstream OpenAPI export

get.description: Persistent session SSE stream. Resume with after_seq; terminal turn events do not close the session stream. Heartbeat comments are ignored. Source: https://zai-zjy.sh.oop.cc/docs/zai/coding/events

parameters.name: after_seq
parameters.description: Replay events after this sequence, then follow new events.

200.description: SSE frames contain full persisted events with seq, type, turn_id, payload and created_at. EOF ends this connection and does not imply turn success; no [DONE] sentinel is required.
